title: 构建AI就绪的东盟
summary: AI准备就绪东盟倡议旨在2026年前为550万东盟公民普及AI知识。新加坡AI培训青年、教育工作者和家长成为主讲师，推广AI素养。
summaryEn: AI Ready ASEAN aims to empower 5.5 million ASEAN citizens with AI knowledge by 2026. AI Singapore trains Master Trainers among youth, educators and parents to build AI literacy in communities.
speaker: AI Singapore
speakerTitle: AI 研究与人才培养机构
